text:
Ana: Okay this is adorable and chaotic — Sung and Priya just told me they're renewing their vows next month AND adopting a rescue bunny named Mochi 🐰❤️. Small ceremony + rooftop brunch after. They asked if we'd love a group card and a few people to bring brunch things. Who's in?
Devin: WHAT!! congrats to them both :party_parrot: sign me up for savory pastries.
Courtney (People Ops): Love this. Congrats!! Do they want donations or physical gifts? Also any date/RSVP details yet?
Ana: Priya said they don't want a huge registry, just a couple small things — snacks, plants, or a card. Date is 2026-06-12 (afternoon). RSVP flexible.
Oliver: I can bring a quiche or two. Do we have a card/potluck sign-up link?
Priya: Hi all! Thanks so much ❤️ We really appreciate anything — plants are big yes, Mochi is already obsessed with stray socks though so maybe skip the tiny plushies 😂 Ceremony is tiny, brunch after on the roof at 1pm. No stress about gifts at all.
Sung: Also we'll be popping by the office the week before for a quick hello if anyone wants to meet Mochi in person — very low-key.
Devin: awww can't wait. I nominate a carrot cake (for Mochi?) and a very small carrot bouquet.
Courtney (People Ops): I'll set up a volunteer sheet and a digital card. Card Bot, can you make an e-card thread?
Card Bot: Created e-card: https://redwood.cards/e/2101239876 — feel free to add messages!
Ana: I'll drop a Google sheet with potluck items in #random in 5. Also thinking to chip in for a plant from the office plant fund, anyone wanna contribute?
Oliver: Count me in for the plant fund. Maybe a low-light philodendron?
Priya: Philodendron would be perfect, thanks everyone. This is so sweet.
Sung: Big love to the team — can't wait to celebrate with you all. :heart_eyes:
